question: Which of the following religious communities in India primarily celebrates the Pateti festival?
solution:
The correct answer is Parsi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pateti is the **new year festival** of the Parsis.
 
• Pateti comes from the Persian word '**Patet'** which means '**confession' or 'repentance'.**
 
• On this festival, Parsis mark the beginning of the new year, go to the agyari and spend the day with family members.
 
• The Parsis don’t just believe in celebrating the new year and forgetting about the past. Rather they cherish the past and look back on the year that has passed and ask for repentance.
 
• This generally occurs just before the New year or the last day of the previous year and usually encompasses **5 days **of repentance which has now been reduced to **one**. 
 
• New year's day which historically falls on the **spring equinox** is now celebrated in **mid-August every year**.
 
• The **Shahenshahi** calendar used by the Parsis is itself known as **Nowroz.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Parsi community**

 
 
• **​**One of the most well-known minority communities in the country is the Parsis who follow the **4000-year-old** ancient **Zoroastrianism religion** from **Persia**.
 
• Zoroastrianism spread to the world via the Silk Route and influenced other religions such as Judaism and Christianity. It is a monotheistic religion established by the Prophet Zarathustra who was the contemporary of Cyrus the Great, back in 1200 BC.
 
• The Parsis, came to India after the Arab conquest started. Historians believe that they sailed across the Arabian Sea to reach **Gujarat sometime in 785 AD.** Today, around **60,000** Parsis reside in the country.
 
• The Parsis are a distinctive community in the country who are known for their distinct cuisine and way of life. Many of them such as **Jamshedji Tata** have contributed to building this nation.
 
• This community is predominantly based in the western region, especially in **Maharashtra and Gujarat.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Islam (Muslim) religion -**

 
 
• **Hazrat Muhammad Sahib **was the founder of the Islam religion.
 
• Hazrat Muhammad Sahib was born in Mecca in 570 AD.
 
• Hazrat Muhammad Sahib died in 632 AD. After his death, Islam got divided into two sects called **Sunni and Shia**.
 
• The successors of Prophet Muhammad were called **Khalifa**.
 
 
 
• **Sikh religion -**
 
 
• The credit for the establishment of the Sikh religion goes to **Guru Nanak (the first Guru).** The followers of Guru Nanak are called **Sikhs**.
 
• There are 10 Gurus in Sikhism. 10th Guru was **Guru Govind Singh Ji.**
 
• In **1699** AD, on the day of Baisakhi, Guru Gobind Singh established the **Khalsa Panth.**
